description: Every loan_id should be unique — a duplicate would double-count exposure.
No nulls expected in any field except ltv (which is null by design for unsecured/other collateral).
ltv should be populated only for residential/commercial collateral, and null otherwise.
borrower_risk_grade/collateral_type/amortisation_type/status must be one of their defined allowed values.
Every loan in a 'current' portfolio snapshot should still be active (maturity_date > reporting_date) — this check caught a real Phase 2 bug, see docs/methodology.md.
Every loan_id in amortisation_schedules.parquet should exist in loan_portfolio.parquet.
Every loan in loan_portfolio.parquet should have at least one row in amortisation_schedules.parquet.
loan_portfolio.parquet and ecl_results.parquet should contain exactly the same set of loan_ids.
